Hadith.4758 - Samaʿah asked Abu Abdullah (as) about where a divorced woman should observe her waiting period (ʿiddah).
Imam (as) replied: "In her house; she should not leave.

If she wishes to visit someone, she may go out before midnight and return after midnight. She should not go out during the day, and she is not permitted to perform Hajj until her waiting period is complete."
